summary: Feed s162_triple to NDR is degraded with 3 faults: VLAN 20 missing (49% untagged), 6.8% TCP packet drops, and 92.7% encrypted traffic exceeding 90% tolerance. NDR requires both directions and full payload for VLANs 10,20 but is blind to VLAN 20, missing reassembled flows, and limited to metadata on most traffic.

findings.root_cause: Required VLAN 20 not seen and 49% of packets are untagged. Most likely the TAP/SPAN or packet broker ingress is stripping 802.1Q tags or not configured to forward VLAN 20 to this NDR tool port.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR is blind to all traffic on VLAN 20 (half of its required coverage). Cannot detect lateral movement or segmentation violations involving VLAN 20, and VLAN-aware detection policies will not fire.

recommended_fix.why: Configure TAP/broker ingress and egress to preserve 802.1Q tags and explicitly forward VLANs 10 and 20 to the NDR port so required segmentation is visible.

findings.root_cause: 6.85% of TCP packets (186/2716) show gaps/retransmissions indicating missing data. With tool_overload healthy and 10G tool port, drops are occurring upstream - likely SPAN oversubscription or packet broker egress congestion dropping packets before NDR.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR cannot reliably reassemble TCP streams or perform full-payload inspection. Dropped packets cause missed flows, broken file extraction, and missed IDS signatures - high risk of false negatives.

recommended_fix.why: Load-balance or aggregate across additional NDR tool ports / reduce oversubscription and replace SPAN with TAP if SPAN is dropping, to eliminate 6%+ loss and restore complete TCP reassembly.

findings.root_cause: 92.75% of bytes are encrypted vs NDR tolerance of 90%. Traffic is predominantly TLS without broker-based decryption, leaving payload opaque.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs full payload but can only do metadata/JA3 analysis on ~93% of traffic. Encrypted attacks, C2, and data exfiltration inside TLS will be missed.

recommended_fix.why: Add selective TLS decryption at packet broker (or forward keys) for NDR inspection while respecting privacy policy, to bring visible payload below 90% threshold.
